name: Zuffa Boxing (TKO-Sela joint venture)
note: Incorporated as Boxing OpCo, LLC (Sep 2024); announced 5 Mar 2025 as a TKO-Sela partnership with Turki Alalshikh, TKO as managing partner. Sela 60 / TKO 40 split per Thomas Hauser, The Guardian, 28 Jan 2026 ('Sela owns 60% of Zuffa Boxing and TKO owns 40%'); single-source, check TKO filings. Co-founded by Dana White and Turki Alalshikh.
